race.comment: Connections had such a high opinion of VATICAN (7) that they debuted him in a Listed race where he certainly wasn't disgraced, finishing fifth only two lengths away. Has since been tipped out for further time to furnish and has tuned up for this with two recent trials. Gets the reliable Waller/JMac combination and can return a winner. BETTER BY FAR (8) is unlucky to still be a maiden finishing runner-up in both starts to date and strikes a very winnable contest here. Looms as the main danger. CZECH ME (2) was well in the betting on debut but just ran into one better on that occasion. Where there's smoke there's fire and should be kept very safe. SNITZEL'S GIRL (13) is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley and looks a must for the multiples. KEEN TO EXCEED (4) next in line.
